tuning: One configuration per algorithm selected only from the disjoint pilot trials by the frozen mean-RPD rule; GA defaults retained because configuration zero won
execution: Four independent Python processes with larger instances scheduled first; algorithms and seeds execute sequentially within each instance

analysis_plan.unit: 18 paired instance means, averaging the same 20 seeds
analysis_plan.within_setting: Friedman with 99999 within-instance permutations; all six exact two-sided Wilcoxon comparisons with Holm correction
analysis_plan.tuning_comparison: Four exact two-sided Wilcoxon tests of tuned-minus-untuned mean RPD, Holm correction across algorithms; equal budgets and no shared-prefix assumption when settings change
analysis_plan.caveat: Earlier benchmark results were already known, but selection read only pilot outcomes; no retuning after the final rerun
